headline: Clinton order aimed at better coordinating the federal government's international exchange and training programs.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this 1997 executive order deals with how federal agencies coordinate the international exchange and training programs they run. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it takes, such as which offices are involved or what they must do, cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run international exchange or training programs
who_it_affects.how: The order appears to set expectations for how these agencies coordinate their programs with one another.

who_it_affects.group: People who take part in US government exchange and training programs
who_it_affects.how: They may be indirectly affected by changes in how these programs are organized, though the details are not available.

when_it_takes_effect: 1997-07-15 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in the source material)
